records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 SEC earnings deck
records.note: Q3 company-reported: revenue $1.216B; transaction revenue $590.2M (-43% YoY); subscription/services $570M; stablecoin revenue $307M; average USDC held in Coinbase products $22B; global trading-volume share 10.7%; platform assets $377B; adjusted EBITDA $332.9M. GAAP profit includes a large crypto-investment gain; adjusted net income about $77.7M. Not XRP-specific flows.

records.title: Ripple and Coinbase partner to expand RLUSD access
records.note: Oct 28 announcement: RLUSD live through Coinbase Prime, Exchange and retail; XRPL/Base/Ethereum deposits and withdrawals. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability is future, not live. Ripple reports RLUSD market cap above $2.4B. No XRP price effect or realized payment volume established.

records.title: Ripple reports product revenue run rate and institutional partnerships
records.note: Ripple-reported Oct 28: ~$900M annualized product-revenue run rate, >$16T transactions enabled across products in 2025, 1,700+ institutions/corporates/enterprises, 85+ licenses, RLUSD market cap $2.6B. Issuer corporate claims, not audited XRP-specific volume or capital flows.

records.title: Circle USDC circulation and reserve transparency
records.note: As of Oct 26: $71.0B circulation, $71.2B reserves; 7-day issuance/redemption net -$1.0B; 30-day net -$4.2B; 365-day net -$5.2B. Issuer-reported supply does not identify destination assets or rotation into XRP/RLUSD.

records.title: Circle launches native USDC on XRPL
records.note: Circle announced native USDC on XRPL Jun 12, 2025; Circle Mint and APIs support access without third-party bridging. Direct Circle-to-XRPL product presence, not proof of a Ripple commercial partnership or XRP bridge demand.

records.title: Reuters: Binance says $2.54B assets frozen during security investigation
records.note: Reuters Oct 29: Binance said $2.54B assets frozen during potential security investigation; Tether nearly $1.57B, Circle >$800M, Yi He attributed roughly $200M to Ripple. Binance said user funds safe; cause/losses unconfirmed. Ripple asset, chain, addresses and custody mechanism unidentified.

records.title: AP: Binance flags potential security incident as crypto firms freeze assets
records.note: AP independently reports the potential security incident and issuer/custodian freezes; corroborates investigation and Binance user-funds-safe statement but does not audit amounts or identify Ripple's $200M asset.

records.title: Alpha Finance XRP ETF tracker
records.note: XRP-specific page reports $0 Oct 28 net flow across five spot funds and +$90.4M over 30 trading sessions. Different window/population from XRP Insights and Alpha's calendar-day cross-asset page; Oct 29 XRP row not settled at capture.

records.title: Alpha Finance cross-asset ETF tracker
records.note: Through Oct 29 page reports XRP +$10.9M over 30 calendar days and +$291.5M over 90 days, XRP row through Oct 28. Not directly comparable to +$90.4M over 30 trading sessions; no issuer-level crosswalk.

records.title: Bitnomial Clearinghouse accepted collateral and haircuts
records.note: Official Oct 2 page identifies CFTC-registered DCO; accepted XRP collateral haircut 40%, notional limit $15M; BTC 15%/$100M, ETH 20%/$45M. Venue-specific acceptance, not blanket CFTC approval or proof of utilization.

records.title: Bitnomial announces RLUSD and XRP margin collateral
records.note: Nov 3, 2025 announcement says institutional RLUSD and XRP margin deposits for leveraged perpetuals, futures and options, subject to approvals. Quotes Ripple SVP Jack McDonald describing an extension of the Bitnomial/Ripple relationship.

records.title: CFTC announces digital-assets collateral pilot
records.note: CFTC release 9146-25, Dec 8, 2025, announces pilot and explicitly names BTC, ETH and USDC; XRP is not named in that release. Separate from Bitnomial venue-specific XRP collateral acceptance.

records.title: XRPL docs: freezing issued tokens versus native XRP
records.note: XRPL docs: issuer freeze controls apply to issued tokens, not native XRP; no one can freeze XRP on-ledger. Custodial exchanges can restrict assets held in their own custody. Ripple's reported $200M cannot be described as an issuer freeze of native XRP; asset and custody path unknown.

records.title: XRPL rippled 3.3.0 release and amendment bundle
records.note: Official Aug 6 release includes BatchV1_1, ConfidentialTransfer, DynamicMPT, PermissionDelegationV1_1, Sponsor and fixCleanup3_3_0. Inclusion in software release is not mainnet activation.

records.title: XLS-96 Confidential Transfers for MPTs
records.note: Final standard specifies confidential MPT balances/transfers using EC-ElGamal and ZKPs. Requires ConfidentialTransfer amendment; final standard status is not mainnet activation.

records.title: XLS-68 Sponsored Fees and Reserves
records.note: Final standard specifies fee/reserve sponsorship while users retain key control. Requires Sponsor amendment; final standard status is not mainnet activation.

records.title: XRPL Dashboard amendment status from independent node
records.note: Oct 29 ~20:44 UTC: BatchV1_1 and PermissionDelegationV1_1 reported enabled; ConfidentialTransfer 18/35, DynamicMPT 14/35, Sponsor 8/35; fixCleanup3_4_0 33/35. Third-party node observation; exact counts need point-in-time API corroboration.

records.title: XRPL.to amendment status snapshot
records.note: Oct 29 snapshot reports ConfidentialTransfer 19/35, DynamicMPT 15/35, Sponsor 9/35, fixCleanup3_4_0 33/35. Counts differ by one from another node dashboard, but the three institutional amendments remain below 29/35 in both; do not average.

records.title: Public video candidate on XRP collateral and regulated derivatives
records.note: Candidate attributed to Kamilah Stevenson | XRP & Stocks, dated Dec 6, 2025 in prior inventory. XRP collateral claim is partly supported by Bitnomial's CFTC-registered DCO but overgeneralized if presented as blanket CFTC pilot approval or equivalent treatment to Treasuries/gold/FX. Bitnomial lists 40% haircut and $15M cap. Identity versus Camilla Stephenson unresolved.

records.title: Public video candidate on XRPL 3.3.0 amendments
records.note: Candidate attributed to Kamilah/Camila Stevenson, dated Jul 30, 2026 in prior inventory. Feature list aligns with 3.3.0 release, but all features were not live Oct 29: BatchV1_1 and PermissionDelegationV1_1 reported enabled; ConfidentialTransfer, DynamicMPT and Sponsor below threshold. Identity unresolved.

records.title: Public video candidate: XRP and future macro/payment rails
records.note: Candidate attributed to Kamilah/Camila Stevenson, dated Mar 3, 2026 in prior inventory. Advances macro/de-dollarization and bridge-asset thesis; must be tested against route-level payment volumes, settlement inventories and capital flows. Identity unresolved.

records.title: XRP ledger validator failure on PR #1353 head b9562ec
records.note: Exact-head push validation failed 1 test/11 passed. Root cause: validator required every immutable archive shard's creation-time chunk_count to equal current pointer total; historical shards retained earlier generation counts.

records.title: XRP ledger append-generation validator fix exact-head CI
records.note: On PR #1353 head 7074a97, dedicated validator passed 15 tests in 0.06s; Python compilation passed. Fix validates global chunk index and permits immutable shard generation count when >= global_index+1 and <= pointer total. Fail-closed gate 40984074773 passed.

records.title: Controlled-approval workflow push event fails with zero jobs
records.note: Push run on research branch head 7074a97 reports event=push and failure, zero jobs. Inspected main/research workflow files declare workflow_dispatch only. Event/version discrepancy unresolved.

records.title: B-Agent current main and open safety PR inventory
records.note: Main observed at 0b20a401. PR #1353 is an open draft targeting the dedicated research branch, not main. PRs #1349, #1355, #1356, #1357, #1358 and #1359 are open drafts/unmerged. Overlaps: ci.yml in #1355/#1358; tests/test_v3_scripts.py in #1356/#1357/#1359. No PR merged in this run.
